Sources: Redfin (NWMLS feed) + LandWatch, from the daily listing-watcher panel; Zillow is not a panel source — links open the listing’s own page. Drive times marked ≈ are area-level estimates (Valhalla / calibrated OSRM to a nearby anchor); opening a listing fetches its exact route, shown as “(routed)”, typically within ~10% of Google. San Juan routes assume the Anacortes ferry and exclude wait time. Offline fallback = straight-line estimate (marked “est.”).
